label: Bible Study
prompt: _____ unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
verse: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
note: David's prayer after Nathan confronted him — he asks for the joy back, not just the forgiveness.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an _____ of God through Christ.
verse: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
note: No longer a servant but a son — and sons inherit. Paul says you're an heir of God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal _____ of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a garment of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.
verse: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a garment of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.
note: Mordecai walked out in royal blue and white, with a great crown of gold — and the city of Shushan rejoiced.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without _____:
verse: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
note: Paul's case from creation: the world is a signed masterpiece, so no one can plead total ignorance of the Artist.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Casting down _____, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
verse: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
note: Spiritual warfare, Pauline style: casting down 'imaginations' and taking every thought captive.
